meta.title: Per-conversation outputs dsh-session-outputs
meta.description: Gives every conversation its own outputs folder and adds a "This conversation" panel to the right sidebar that lists only the files that conversation produced, each one click away from a preview. For people who start several conversations a day and can no longer tell which one wrote which file. It does not: rewrite a session's recorded cwd, move or delete existing files, run git commands, or replace the built-in Files page, which still browses the whole workspace.
